testcase.name: Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 1. registers and logs in test user; captures user ID and stripeCustomerId
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 2. webhook endpoint exists (not 404)
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 3. rejects webhook with no stripe-signature header
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 4. rejects webhook with an invalid stripe-signature header
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 5. a signed subscription event cannot grant entitlement without current provider verification
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 6. checkout.session.completed (subscription mode) updates subscription_tier
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 7. idempotency: same event ID fired twice — second response is idempotent, tier unchanged
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 8. a valid signed event cannot replace a user's tier from unverified payload metadata
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 9. GET /api/billing/subscription returns complete tier shape when authenticated
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 10. GET /api/billing/subscription returns 401 when unauthenticated
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 11. GET /api/billing/plans returns a non-empty plan list without auth
Billing Webhook Lifecycle > 12. POST /api/billing/create-checkout-session rejects invalid plan
